name: Auto-lock
author: dbarke
description: Automatic screen lock that follows the network you are on: off on the networks you call home, on everywhere else, and one click to override until you move.

barWidget.description: Shows whether the screen will lock itself. Joining a network applies that network's setting; marking the current network as home stops it locking there. Clicking overrides the setting until you switch networks.

schema.label: Network check interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to ask NetworkManager which network is active. Changes to the lock state itself are picked up immediately regardless.
